contrast_definitions.GB_oldD_to_newD: Old shipped GB versus new shipped GB: total release shift
contrast_definitions.HGB_old255_to_new255: Old runtime with max_bins=255 versus new shipped HGB with max_bins=255: remaining cross-runtime difference; other configuration/implementation changes uncontrolled
contrast_definitions.HGB_old256_to_old255: Within-old-runtime HGB change in max_bins only
contrast_definitions.HGB_oldD_to_newD: Old shipped HGB (max_bins=256) versus new shipped HGB (max_bins=255): total release shift

limitations: Equal max_bins values do not by themselves imply equivalent full parameter configurations or implementations
Absolute contrasts need not add; signed fold-level differences do add under paired fold keys
The within-old-runtime max_bins change does not identify default-driven impact on the newer runtime
All 63 datasets are the finite eligible frame; inference beyond the frame requires additional assumptions
scope: 63 datasets and 30 paired folds; cross-release boosting contrasts
